summary: A Database Management System (DBMS) is software that manages data efficiently, ensuring security, consistency, and accessibility. It stores large amounts of data, retrieves it quickly using queries, reduces redundancy, maintains integrity, supports multiple users, facilitates backup and recovery, and processes SQL queries. DBMS advantages include eliminating duplicate data, improving data consistency, providing better security, enabling data sharing, simplifying management, supporting backup/recovery, and ensuring efficient retrieval. However, it can be expensive to implement, requires skilled administrators, has a complex architecture, and may have performance overhead for small applications with high maintenance costs.
